notes.title: Flappatron Tutorial added + other Quality of life changes
notes.notes:
Flappatron Big Update!


Version 1.28
With Episode 2 releasing in November and the Halloween sale approaching we have updated the game with some quality of life changes as well as a brand new tutorial mode! Full details below:
Tutorial Mode added
Game changes
Triggered gun will no longer be interrupted by special attacks (Alien is an expectation)
Clinking Man’s special attack has been changed
Alien’s special attack is now faster
Updates to the main menu
Can now use the triggered gun during mind control

Thank you so much for playing the game!
